note: Sourced facts for fact cards. Each 'fit' lists what must be visible in a clip for the fact to be about it.

facts.fact: Pharsa's "Seasworn Oracle" skin came with the 2026 ALLSTAR event, alongside a "Seasworn Seeker" painted version, and was only available for a limited time.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "The new Pharsa "Seasworn Oracle" Skin, Pharsa "Seasworn Seeker" Painted skin, and Julian "Phantom Current" Skin will also be available for a limited time."

facts.fact: Pharsa is a long-range mage who deals area-of-effect damage.
facts.flag: Single source (TheGamer). From an older tier list; its opinion on her ultimate is left out.
facts.quote: TheGamer: "Another AoE mage with a long-range"

facts.fact: For 2026 ALLSTAR, starting 30 April, the Land of Dawn map was plunged beneath the waves, with submerged ruins to explore.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "From 30 April, ALLSTAR returns, plunging the Land of Dawn beneath the waves." | MOONTON Games: "Navigate submerged ruins, face the revamped Siren Lord"

facts.fact: The 2026 ALLSTAR map added the Siren Lord, a fearsome evolution of the Elemental Lord that turns the tide of the game for the team that takes her down.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "From the depths emerges the Siren Lord, a fearsome evolution of the Elemental Lord that turns the tide of game for those who take her down."

facts.fact: During 2026 ALLSTAR, teams earned Treasure Hunt Coins by taking neutral objectives, destroying turrets or finding hidden drops, and the coins gave a chance to win real gold merchandise.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "Earn Treasure Hunt Coins with your team by securing neutral objectives, destroying turrets, or uncovering hidden drops." | MOONTON Games: "Treasure Hunt Coins can be used in 2026 ALLSTAR events for a chance to win real gold merchandise."

facts.fact: 2026 ALLSTAR also had a Tidal Fishing mini-game, with fish in Green, Blue, Purple and Rare rarities.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "Cast a line in Tidal Fishing from 15 May to 28 June. Complete mini-game tasks to earn bait and reel in fish of different rarities: Green, Blue, Purple, and Rare."

facts.fact: The year before, ALLSTAR 2025 turned the map into a dinosaur world where the Lord became Lord Pterosaur, which a team could tame to fight on its side.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "Lord Pterosaur now wields Bombardments that deal heavy damage to nearby heroes. Teams must unite to conquer and tame this mighty beast, turning him into their powerful ally."

facts.fact: Project NEXT 2025 brought four new maps: Broken Walls, Dangerous Grass, Flying Cloud and Expanding Rivers. Which one you get is decided during hero selection.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "These new maps are randomly available and will be determined during the hero selection phase." | MOONTON Games: "namely Broken Walls, Dangerous Grass, Flying Cloud, or Expanding Rivers."

facts.fact: On the Flying Cloud map, a platform near the base can carry a newly respawned hero, hovering for five seconds beyond the high ground.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "Found near the base, the Flying Cloud platform can transport a newly-respawned hero by entering the flight state and hovering for five seconds beyond the higher ground."

facts.fact: On the Broken Walls map, junglers can enter the pit from behind to steal the Lord or the Turtle.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "Meanwhile, junglers can now enter the pit from behind to steal the Lord or Turtle."

facts.fact: Mobile Legends matches last around 10 minutes, matchmaking is designed to get you into a game in just 10 seconds, and the controls can be played with just two fingers.
facts.quote: Game Rant: "Matches are short, lasting around 10 minutes, with a system designed to get players into a game in just 10 seconds. The controls are incredibly intuitive and can be played with just two fingers"

facts.fact: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang launched in 2016 and has over 1.5 billion installs and 110 million monthly active users.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "Since its launch in 2016, MLBB has grown into one of the world's most popular mobile games, recording over 1.5 billion installations and 110 million Monthly Active Users (MAU) worldwide."

facts.fact: Nearly one in five Malaysians plays Mobile Legends every month, and the game passed 90 million downloads in Malaysia.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "MOONTON Games announced that Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) has surpassed 90 million cumulative downloads in Malaysia. Nearly one in five Malaysians plays MLBB each month"

facts.fact: For the game's 10th anniversary, Indonesia built an eight-metre-tall sculpture of the Lord.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "In Indonesia, an eight-metre-tall "Lord" sculpture brought one of MLBB's most iconic in-game elements to life."

facts.fact: Fnatic ONIC Philippines won the M6 World Championship by beating Team Liquid Indonesia 4:1, the Philippines' fifth M Series title in a row since M2 in 2021.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "The M6 World Championship Grand Finals concluded yesterday (14 December) with Fnatic Onic Philippines (FNOP) defeating Team Liquid Indonesia (TLID) 4:1 in a best-of-seven (BO7) series. Their victory marks the Philippines' fifth consecutive M Series title since the M2 World Championship in 2021."

facts.fact: The M6 Finals MVP skin for Beatrix, "Sky Force Maverick", has a hedgehog charm and the name of Kelra's child, "Slake", on the outfit.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "From a playful hedgehog charm at her waist to Kelra's child's name, "Slake", emblazoned on the outfit"

facts.fact: Aurora Gaming PH won the M7 World Championship in Jakarta, which brought 22 teams together in January 2026 for a 1 million US dollar prize pool.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "The M7 World Championship (M7) concluded today in Jakarta with an electrifying Grand Finals that marked the crowning of new the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) world champions, Aurora Gaming PH (RORA)." | MOONTON Games: "bringing 22 of the world's top teams to Jakarta, Indonesia, from 3 to 25 January 2026 to compete for a USD 1 million prize pool."

facts.fact: At its peak, more than 5.68 million fans were watching the M7 World Championship at once, a bigger peak than any other esports game had in that quarter.
facts.quote: Insider Gaming: "In January, the $1 million M7 World Championship unfolded in Indonesia, and at one point, more than 5.68 million fans were tuned into the action." | Insider Gaming: "the M7 World Championship pulled in a peak viewer count of more than 5.68 million users, dwarfing every other esports title during Q1."

facts.fact: ECHO beat Blacklist International 4-0 in an all-Filipino M4 World Championship final.
facts.quote: Dexerto: "they were no match for their Filipino rival ECHO, who ran out 4-0 winners in a one-sided final."

facts.fact: The M4 World Championship peaked at over 4.2 million viewers, one of the most popular tournaments in esports history.
facts.quote: Dexerto: "the M4 World Championship, which became one of the most popular tournaments in esports history with a peak of over 4.2 million viewers."

facts.fact: The M8 World Championship Finals in Istanbul will be the first time the M Series is held in Europe.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "the M8 World Championship Finals in Istanbul, Türkiye, will mark the M Series' historic European debut, bringing the pinnacle of MLBB Esports to the continent for the first time."

facts.fact: Mobile Legends made its Asian Games debut as a medal event in 2026, and Myanmar won the first gold by sweeping Indonesia 4-0.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "The result makes Myanmar the first-ever Asian Games gold medallist in MLBB, following the title's debut as an official medal event at Aichi-Nagoya 2026." | MOONTON Games: "sweeping Indonesia 4-0"

facts.fact: The Mobile Legends Asian Games Qualifiers became the most-watched esports tournament in Asian Games history by hours watched, with 10.1 million hours.
facts.quote: MOONTON Games: "The recently concluded MLBB Asian Games Qualifiers (AGQ) became the most-watched esports tournament in Asian Games history by Hours Watched (HW), generating 10.1 million HW according to Esports Charts."

facts.fact: ByteDance agreed to sell Moonton, the maker of Mobile Legends, to Savvy Games Group for 6 billion US dollars.
facts.quote: Engadget: "ByteDance has agreed to sell its games unit Moonton to Savvy Games Group for $6 billion."
